commitResults.messageTitle: Editted new name and banner for Chatbot
added echo and exit with bye
Added ability to mark task as Done, added Task file
Added Todo,Deadline,Event class to have multiple classes
Added RamlyException Class and handled some exceptions
Added Delete feature and handled more exceptions
Extract console input into Ui class
commitResults.messageBody: Move Scanner construction, command reading, and cleanup behind Ui so Ramly can focus on application flow. Keep existing output behavior unchanged as a low-risk first extraction step.
Encapsulate the startup banner and greeting in Ui so Ramly no longer owns this console presentation detail.
Use Ui for all command-loop separators and remove the presentation constant from Ramly, keeping application behavior unchanged.
Delegate list command messages and task rendering to Ui so Ramly retains only the list control flow.
Delegate mark and unmark success and validation messages to Ui while keeping task state changes in Ramly.
Delegate todo, deadline, and event confirmation and validation messages to Ui while preserving Ramly's command behavior.
Delegate delete confirmations, numeric validation, and unknown-command responses to Ui while leaving task operations in Ramly.
Introduce a Parser class and move deadline command splitting out of Ramly, establishing a focused parsing responsibility without changing behavior.
Centralize todo description extraction and event field splitting in Parser, reducing command syntax handling in Ramly.
Introduce TaskList for task counting, lookup, addition, and removal while preserving Storage as the persistence boundary.
Remove the ArrayList exposure from TaskList and let Storage iterate over the collection abstraction directly, tightening ownership boundaries.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task index parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Centralize conversion of one-based task numbers to zero-based indexes for mark, unmark, and delete commands.
Route prefixed command checks through Parser while preserving exact matching for bye and list, keeping existing command semantics intact.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract exit behavior into command object
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce the Command abstraction and ExitCommand, and make Parser create an executable exit command for bye while preserving existing handling for other commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract list behavior into command object
commitResults.messageBody: Add ListCommand and have Parser create it for list, moving task display decisions out of Ramly while retaining command-loop control.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract delete behavior into command object
commitResults.messageBody: Add DeleteCommand for task removal, persistence, validation, and feedback, and dispatch delete commands through Parser.
Add dedicated command objects for task state changes, validation, persistence, and feedback, and dispatch them through Parser.
Add dedicated commands for todo, deadline, and event creation, including persistence and user feedback, and remove their execution branches from Ramly.
Add UnknownCommand and make Parser return a command for unrecognized input, removing Ramly's fallback error branch.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle invalid deadline values in command
commitResults.messageBody: Keep malformed deadline input inside DeadlineCommand by reporting parse failures without mutating or persisting the task list.
Add collaborators, constructor, and run method to Ramly so main only creates and starts the application, matching the command-oriented architecture.
Add Ui.showError and catch unexpected runtime failures around parse and execute so malformed commands do not terminate the application.
Add CommandType and replace Parser's command-recognition chain with classification and switch-based command construction for easier extension.
Introduce TaskStateCommand to centralize index validation, state updates, persistence, and feedback for mark and unmark commands.
Introduce AddTaskCommand to centralize task creation feedback, persistence, and deadline validation across todo, deadline, and event commands.

Group commands, models, parsing, storage, UI, and exceptions into suitable packages beneath the existing src/main/java source root. Update package declarations and imports while preserving runtime behavior.
